column1: # Agent CLIs. Same columns as baseline.tsv:
#   name    unique key; manifest/local/agents.tsv rows with the same key replace these
#   check   command(s) that prove the agent is installed; an agent installed any other way is left alone
#   group   baseline (installed by --apply) or the optional module that installs it
#   macos   npm:<package> (installed with npm --prefix ~/.local) | installer:<official install.sh URL>
#   debian  same methods for Ubuntu 24.04 / Debian 12 (x86_64); "-" marks an agent as macOS-only
# Order matters: bun is installed before omp, which needs it.
